observation: Customer operation marks can occur on multiple materials, and visible X or V marks do not by themselves prove a seam, component, or material region.
cause: The prior presentation rule coupled dash-dot marks to wood classification and did not separate symbol appearance from meaning confidence.
proposed_rule: Build a source symbol profile, preserve recognizable marks on their owner faces, keep appearance and meaning confidence separate, and require independent evidence before a symbol changes geometry, inventory, materials, or dimensions.
evidence: Synthetic same-symbol/different-meaning and material-neutral owner-face regression cases
